description: List credit notes (Gutschriften) with compact rows: number, status, contact, date, net/tax/gross, booking category (e.g. UNDERACHIEVEMENT = Minderleistung, PROVISION) and the invoice they refer to (sourceInvoiceId). Filter by status (draft = Entwurf, open, partially_paid, paid), contactId, exact credit note number (Gutschriftsnummer) and date range. Page with offset = nextOffset while hasMore. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_credit_note_get for details and positions. The source invoice: sevdesk_invoice_get.

contactId.description: Only credit notes of this contact.

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

name: sevdesk_credit_notes_list
title: List sevDesk credit notes
